description: This file declares interfaces related to warning reporting, including events, reporting units, and control mechanisms within the WPEFramework namespace. It specifies abstract classes and their methods for warning event serialization, category management, and control behaviors.

classes.name: IWarningEvent
classes.description: Interface for warning events, providing methods for obtaining category, serialization/deserialization, string representation, and warning status.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Interface managing warning reporting operations, category information, and category list modification.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit::IWarningReportingControl
classes.description: Control interface for warning categories, allowing exclusion, configuration, and cloning.

methods.name: ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Reports a warning event with an identifier and event information.

methods.name: FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific warning category, including default status, enabled status, exclusions, and configuration.

methods.name: AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Adds a category control to the list.

methods.name: RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Removes a category control from the list.

methods.name: Exclude
methods.description: Excludes a specified category from reporting.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures a category with specified settings.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the warning reporting control.
